sql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ps.skill = 'rag' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Mentions RAG' ELSE 'Does not mention RAG' END AS rag_mention_status,
  AVG(f.comp_mid_usd) AS median_pay_midpoint
FROM fct_posting AS f
LEFT JOIN posting_skills AS ps ON f.posting_key = ps.posting_key
WHERE f.is_open AND f.remote_us AND f.is_canonical_listing
GROUP BY rag_mention_status;
